title: Bel Announces Richard E. Hamilton as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
summary: WEST ORANGE, N.J., Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bel Fuse Inc. (Nasdaq: BELFA and BELFB) ("Bel" or the "Company"), a global manufacturer of electronic components, systems and solutions, today announced that Richard E. Hamilton will join the Company as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary effective September 28, 2026. Mr. Hamilton will lead Bel’s global legal function and serve as a strategic advisor to the Company’s executive leadership team and Board of Directors.
